SREdit-Bench: A Benchmark for Spatial Reasoning in Image Editing
	





	
		
	
	
		Dataset Description
	

SREdit-Bench is a challenging benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the spatial reasoning capabilities of image editing models. While existing benchmarks primarily focus on object-salient scenes, they often under-represent spatially complex editing scenarios (e.g., multiple similar editable entities, non-object-salient scenes, and fine-grained object referral).
